title: ASTRA: Automated Simulation of TRAnsportation networks for SUMO
description: An agent plugin for SUMO that bundles a SUMO expert skill with local MCP tools for OSM-to-SUMO network construction, TLS review, routeability checks, evidence bundles, and feedback-driven simulation repair. ASTRA treats bad metrics, warnings, teleports, disconnected routes, and map disagreements as feedback about the model rather than raw optimization targets.
